suggestions.quote: Sunday dusk. The door. Mom waves.
suggestions.fix: The cues.yaml 'Back to you' `music_in` is "Sunday. The door.", which is a picture, not a spoken line. Name it as a picture event: music_in on 'Mom waves at the door, the auto waiting'. Keep the out cue after the last wave, before the black.

suggestions.quote: Through the window, a station footbridge, packed with people and bags going home for Diwali.
suggestions.fix: This is a new set and a heavy one. To keep the build short, reuse the platform set as the window's far layer, flipped and dimmed to night, with bags added to the figures. Do not build a separate footbridge.

suggestions.quote: The auto pulls away. Through its back window, counters over three heads on the lane
suggestions.fix: The sets in this film are porch, lane, platform, metro, rented room, home interior, carriage cutaway, office, meeting room and dinner table. Build and reuse in this order: porch/door (used 8 times), platform, office (meeting room is the same set with the desk layer swapped), and one 'room' set for the rented room and the home interior with a lamp swap. If the carriage cutaway slips, stage it as the metro set with the pole layer replaced by a seat row.

suggestions.quote: Slow motion. Clack: the counter flips the wrong way. 38. 39.
suggestions.fix: In cues.yaml, third jump, `intent: tense` starts at 'Train.', two beats before the reveal. Keep the tense bed as dry anticipation of the expected drop, and put the intent switch to 'curious/awe' exactly at the upward flip, so the reveal gets the change and not the build.

suggestions.quote: Mom, small in the doorway at the left third, waves back harder.
suggestions.fix: Say where you stand at the corner (centre-left, two-thirds, back to the camera), so that you, mom and the blurred counter all sit in the left two-thirds and the right third stays quiet for end screens. This is a continuity note for the trigger gesture: the half-wave with phone up at the door becomes a full-arm wave with the phone pocketed.

suggestions.quote: You tap the red cross. Clack: 9 rises, but only to 38.
suggestions.fix: That is two flips and a book-and-repeat action in one scene, with no change over about 6 s of action. Split it in two shots: (1) tap the red cross, the flaps run up to 38, close on your blink, 2 s; (2) the train app, repeat icon, flaps run to 260, phone turned face down, 2.5 s.

suggestions.why: sound.md #1: the cue sheet's second-jump `music_out` is keyed to "yours is closer to ninety-nine per cent", a line cut from the narration after G2 round 1 (see 'Not said'). That beat's music out is now on a cue that does not exist in the script, so it has no named cue.
suggestions.fix: In cues.yaml, second jump, change `music_out` to: after "Your strip is thinner.": thins to one piano line (the cost), under the fan hold. Keep the intent as is.

keep.quote: You thought it would drop when you left. It drops when you walk in.
It wasn't her clock. It was your timetable.
Saying no isn't a plan. A ticket is.
